info.name: Online Exam API
info.description:
# Online Exam API

Source-aligned Postman collection for every route currently mounted by the Express application: health, authentication, diplomas, quizzes, and attempts. Each request contains its purpose, authorization and validation contract, and saved response examples.

## Authentication
Protected routes read a raw JWT directly from the `Authorization` header. Login saves the returned JWT to the `accessToken` collection variable automatically; do **not** add a `Bearer ` prefix. New accounts have role `user`. Admin-only operations require changing a user role to `admin` in the database because the API has no role-escalation endpoint.

## Response envelopes
Most successful responses use `{ "statusCode": number, "message": string, "data"?: any }`. Validation failures use `{ "statusCode": 400, "message": "Validation Error", "error": { "field.path": ["message"] } }`. Other handled failures use `{ "statusCode": number, "message": string }`. `/health` is the exception and returns `{ "status": "OK" }`. Unhandled server failures are normalized to status `502` with a generic message.

## Multipart uploads
Do not manually set `Content-Type` for form-data requests; Postman must add the multipart boundary. Quiz and diploma photos accept JPEG, PNG, or WebP up to 2 MB. Quiz `questions` is sent as a JSON-stringified text field.

## Saved examples
ObjectIds, timestamps, generated filenames, and result values are illustrative. Actual values depend on the database and request time.

**Request:** No headers, parameters, or body are required.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Account registration, session revocation, and password-recovery operations.

request.description:
**Purpose:** Creates a new account with the default `user` role. Registration does not authenticate the new user and does not return a JWT.

**Request:** JSON only. `firstName` and `lastName` must each contain at least 5 characters. `email` must be valid. `password` must be 8-64 characters and include lowercase, uppercase, number, and special characters. `confirmPassword` must match.

**Responses:** `201` created; `400` validation error; `409` email already exists.

response.name: 400 - Invalid registration data

request.description:
**Purpose:** Authenticates an account at `POST /auth/login` and returns a raw JWT. This replaces the outdated `GET /auth/login` request.

**Request:** JSON with a valid email and a password of at least 8 characters.

**Post-response:** A successful response saves `data.token` to the `accessToken` collection variable for protected requests.

**Responses:** `200` authenticated; `400` request validation error; `401` invalid credentials; `404` user not found.

response.name: 400 - Invalid login body

request.description:
**Purpose:** Revokes the current JWT by its JWT ID so it cannot be reused.

**Authentication:** Required. The server expects the raw JWT in the `Authorization` header. Do not prepend `Bearer `. This request uses the `accessToken` collection variable.

**Request:** No body.

**Responses:** `200` token revoked; `401` token missing, invalid, expired, already revoked, or invalidated by a password change.

**Purpose:** Sends a six-digit password-reset OTP to a registered email. The OTP expires after 2 minutes. The endpoint intentionally returns the same success response when the email is unknown to avoid account enumeration.

**Request:** JSON containing one valid `email`; unknown fields are rejected.

**Rate limits:** A new code cannot be requested while the current one is valid. A temporarily blocked user receives `429`.

**Responses:** `200` request accepted; `400` validation error; `429` resend/block limit.

response.name: 429 - Code requested too soon

request.description:
**Purpose:** Verifies the active password-reset OTP. A valid verification marker remains usable for password reset for 10 minutes. Unknown emails intentionally receive the same `200` response to reduce account enumeration.

**Request:** JSON with a valid `email` and an `otp` containing exactly six digits.

**Attempt policy:** Wrong codes return `401`. On the fifth failed attempt, the OTP is deleted and verification is blocked for 7 minutes.

**Responses:** `200` verified/unknown email; `400` validation error; `401` wrong code; `404` missing or expired code; `409` already verified; `429` blocked.

response.name: 404 - OTP missing or expired
429 - Too many failed attempts

request.description:
**Purpose:** Replaces the password after successful OTP verification, archives the previous password hash, invalidates older JWTs, and consumes the OTP so it cannot be reused.

**Request:** JSON with `email`, `newPassword`, and matching `confirmPassword`. The new password must be at least 8 characters and contain an uppercase letter, number, and symbol.

**Responses:** `200` reset; `400` validation error; `403` OTP exists but was not verified; `404` user or OTP not found/expired.

response.name: 404 - OTP missing or expired

item.name: Diplomas
item.description: Diploma/track catalog. Admins create; users and admins list.

formdata.description: Required non-blank name; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.
Required non-blank description; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.
Optional JPEG, PNG, or WebP file, maximum 2 MB.

request.description:
**Purpose:** Creates a diploma/learning track that quizzes can reference.

**Authentication:** Required. The server expects the raw JWT in the `Authorization` header. Do not prepend `Bearer `. This request uses the `accessToken` collection variable.

**Role:** `admin` only.

**Request:** `multipart/form-data`; let Postman set the boundary. Name and description are required, trimmed, and cannot be blank. The disabled photo row is optional; enable it to upload JPEG, PNG, or WebP up to 2 MB. Unknown text fields are rejected.

**Post-response:** A successful response saves `data.diplomaId` to the `diplomaId` collection variable.

**Response photo:** Public path under `/uploads/diploma-photos`, URL-encoded when necessary, or `null`.

**Responses:** `201` created; `400` invalid body/file type; `401` invalid token; `403` non-admin; `413` file over 2 MB.

response.name: 201 - Diploma created without a photo
403 - Admin role required

request.description:
**Purpose:** Returns every diploma/learning track. This endpoint currently has no filtering or pagination.

**Authentication:** Required. The server expects the raw JWT in the `Authorization` header. Do not prepend `Bearer `. This request uses the `accessToken` collection variable.

**Role:** `user` or `admin`.

**Request:** No parameters or body.

**Response photo:** A public path under `/uploads/diploma-photos` or `null`; prepend `baseUrl` to fetch the file.

**Responses:** `200` list (possibly empty); `401` invalid token; `403` unsupported role.

response.name: 200 - Diploma list
403 - Supported role required

item.name: Quizzes
item.description: Quiz administration and authenticated catalog access.

formdata.value: Covers OSI layers, IP addressing, and routing basics.

Required MongoDB ObjectId for an existing diploma.

request.description:
**Purpose:** Creates a quiz under an existing diploma and stores its uploaded cover image.

**Authentication:** Required. The server expects the raw JWT in the `Authorization` header. Do not prepend `Bearer `. This request uses the `accessToken` collection variable.

**Role:** `admin` only.

**Request:** `multipart/form-data`; let Postman generate the boundary. `quizPhoto` is required. `questions` is a JSON-stringified array with 1-10 items. Each question has text (minimum 3 characters), type `radio` or `check`, at least one option whose text is at least 3 characters, and one or more zero-based `correctOptionIndex` values. Indexes must exist; `radio` permits exactly one correct index. `time` is a duration in minutes and must be 30-120. `passingThreshold` defaults to 80. The schema also defines optional `instructions: string[]`; multipart clients must send repeated fields to produce an array, but the current quiz model does not persist this correctly because its stored field is misspelled.

**Post-response:** A successful response saves `data._id` to the `quizId` collection variable.

**Responses:** `201` created; `400` invalid fields/file; `401` invalid token; `403` non-admin; `404` diploma missing; `409` duplicate quiz name; `413` file over 2 MB.

response.name: 201 - Quiz created
400 - Invalid questions
403 - Admin role required
409 - Quiz name already exists

formdata.description: Optional replacement JPEG, PNG, or WebP, maximum 2 MB.

request.description:
**Purpose:** Partially updates a quiz and optionally replaces its photo.

**Authentication:** Required. The server expects the raw JWT in the `Authorization` header. Do not prepend `Bearer `. This request uses the `accessToken` collection variable.

**Role:** `admin` only.

**Path:** `quizId` must be a valid MongoDB ObjectId.

**Request:** `multipart/form-data`; all create fields are optional and retain the same constraints. Only send fields to change. The example photo row is disabled; enable it to replace the image. If `questions` is sent, it must still be a JSON-stringified complete array.

**Responses:** `200` updated; `400` invalid ID/body/file; `401` invalid token; `403` non-admin; `404` quiz or replacement diploma missing; `409` duplicate quiz name; `413` file over 2 MB.

response.name: 200 - Quiz updated
403 - Admin role required
409 - Quiz name already exists

query.description: Optional MongoDB text search over quizName and description.
Optional page number, minimum 1. Pagination activates when provided.
Optional page size, 1-100. Use with page.

request.description:
**Purpose:** Returns quizzes, optionally filtered with text search and paginated.

**Authentication:** Required. The server expects the raw JWT in the `Authorization` header. Do not prepend `Bearer `. This request uses the `accessToken` collection variable.

**Role:** `user` or `admin`.

**Query:** `query` is optional. `page` is >=1 and `size` is 1-100. When `page` is omitted, all matches are returned and `meta` is empty. Supplying `page` without `size` currently produces unreliable pagination, so provide both as in this example.

**Responses:** `200` list; `400` invalid query; `401` invalid token; `403` unsupported role.

response.name: 200 - Paginated quiz list
400 - Invalid page size
403 - Supported role required

request.description:
**Purpose:** Retrieves one quiz by ID, including its answer indexes. Use the sanitized question snapshots returned by Start Attempt for exam delivery instead of exposing this admin-oriented answer data to a quiz-taking UI.

**Authentication:** Required. The server expects the raw JWT in the `Authorization` header. Do not prepend `Bearer `. This request uses the `accessToken` collection variable.

**Role:** `user` or `admin`.

**Path:** `quizId` must be a valid MongoDB ObjectId.

**Responses:** `200` quiz; `400` malformed ID; `401` invalid token; `403` unsupported role; `404` quiz missing.

response.name: 200 - Quiz retrieved
403 - Supported role required

request.description:
**Purpose:** Permanently deletes a quiz document. The current implementation does not remove the stored quiz photo or cascade-delete historical attempts.

**Authentication:** Required. The server expects the raw JWT in the `Authorization` header. Do not prepend `Bearer `. This request uses the `accessToken` collection variable.

**Role:** `admin` only.

**Path:** `quizId` must be a valid MongoDB ObjectId.

**Request:** No body.

**Responses:** `200` deleted; `400` malformed ID; `401` invalid token; `403` non-admin; `404` quiz missing.

response.name: 403 - Admin role required

item.name: Attempts
item.description: Authenticated timed quiz attempts and exact-set grading.

request.description:
**Purpose:** Starts a timed attempt and snapshots the quiz so later quiz edits do not change grading. Correct answers are removed from the response. The quiz duration is converted from minutes to seconds for the attempt timer.

**Authentication:** Required. The server expects the raw JWT in the `Authorization` header. Do not prepend `Bearer `. This request uses the `accessToken` collection variable.

**Role:** `user` or `admin`.

**Path:** `quizId` must be a valid MongoDB ObjectId.

**Request:** No body is required. A caller can have only one `in_progress` attempt across all quizzes; overdue attempts are first marked `expired`.

**Post-response:** A successful response saves the attempt ID plus the first two question IDs and first option IDs to collection variables. Review the selected option variables before submitting.

**Responses:** `201` started; `400` malformed quiz ID or invalid/empty quiz questions; `401` invalid token; `403` unsupported role; `404` quiz missing; `409` active attempt exists.

response.name: 201 - Attempt started
403 - Unsupported role
409 - Another attempt is active

request.description:
**Purpose:** Lists only the authenticated caller's attempts, newest first. Overdue in-progress attempts are marked expired before the query runs.

**Authentication:** Required. The server expects the raw JWT in the `Authorization` header. Do not prepend `Bearer `. This request uses the `accessToken` collection variable.

**Role:** `user` or `admin`.

**Query:** `page` defaults to 1 and `limit` defaults to 10; both must be integers and `limit` cannot exceed 100.

**Response fields:** Scores, pass flags, and submission dates are `null` for unfinished attempts.

**Responses:** `200` list; `400` invalid query; `401` invalid token; `403` unsupported role.

response.name: 400 - Limit exceeds maximum
403 - Unsupported role

request.description:
**Purpose:** Retrieves an attempt owned by the authenticated caller. It never exposes another user's attempt. Overdue attempts are marked expired before retrieval.

**Authentication:** Required. The server expects the raw JWT in the `Authorization` header. Do not prepend `Bearer `. This request uses the `accessToken` collection variable.

**Role:** `user` or `admin`.

**Path:** `attemptId` must be a valid MongoDB ObjectId.

**Answer visibility:** `correctOptionIds` and `isCorrect` are included only when status is `submitted`; they remain hidden for `in_progress` and `expired` attempts. Nullable result fields remain `null` until submission.

**Responses:** `200` detail; `400` malformed ID; `401` invalid token; `403` unsupported role; `404` missing/not-owned attempt or missing snapshot.

response.name: 200 - Submitted attempt with answers revealed
403 - Unsupported role
404 - Attempt not found or not owned

request.description:
**Purpose:** Finalizes and grades an in-progress attempt, stores selected answers, and updates user statistics.

**Authentication:** Required. The server expects the raw JWT in the `Authorization` header. Do not prepend `Bearer `. This request uses the `accessToken` collection variable.

**Role:** `user` or `admin`.

**Path:** `attemptId` must be a valid MongoDB ObjectId and owned by the caller.

**Request:** JSON with exactly one answer for every snapshotted question. IDs must be valid ObjectIds; question IDs cannot repeat; each `selectedOptionIds` array must be non-empty and contain unique options belonging to that question. Grading compares exact option sets, so checkbox answers receive no partial credit. Score is rounded to two decimals. Server-measured time is capped at the attempt time limit.

**Responses:** `200` graded; `400` malformed IDs/body, incomplete answers, or invalid option; `401` invalid token; `403` unsupported role; `404` missing/not-owned attempt or snapshot; `409` submitted, expired, or concurrently finalized attempt.

response.name: 400 - Invalid option for question
403 - Unsupported role
404 - Attempt not found or not owned
